rebuild_notes.status: Rebuilt as a multi-file SwiftUI app while preserving the OldOS visual language.
features_added_beyond_original_extractio: Private Browsing (separate tab pool + non-persistent WKWebsiteDataStore)
Reactive tab state via Combine/KVO instead of NotificationCenter polling
Loading progress bar + HTTPS lock indicator
Request Desktop Website (custom user agent toggle)
Find on Page (iOS 16 WKWebView find interaction)
Unified Library sheet (Bookmarks + History, grouped by day, swipe delete)
Favorites start page for blank tabs
System URL scheme hand-off (tel:, mailto:, maps:, etc.)
Full-bleed chrome behind the status bar / Dynamic Island
fixes: Original single-file prototype referenced a non-existent 'NavTab1' asset image for the 1-tab state; corrected to fall back to the base 'NavTab' asset.
Xcode scheme's BlueprintIdentifier did not match the PBXNativeTarget UUID in project.pbxproj, which would have broken `xcodebuild -scheme OldSafari` in CI; corrected to reference the real target.
